feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. The best raced design is iteration 5 (score 661.4): sensors at y 0.07, kp 1.4, kd 0.5, base_speed 1.0. It finished 20/20 on the oval at 1.98 s and 19/20 on the s-bend at 2.28 s. The slalom still went off_track in all 20 runs at progress 0.311, with max_error at the 0.064 mean and oscillation low at 0.21. Iteration 4 (kd 0.5, y 0.05) also reached 0.306 on the slalom, so sensor lead has not moved the slalom limit. The candidate changes only base_speed, from 1.0 to 0.9, so any change in result is attributable to speed. The reasoning is sound: the slalom has low oscillation and progress stuck near 0.31, which points to speed through its sharp turns rather than steering gain or damping. The off-track limit is max(0.06, 0.0125 + 0.12/4) = 0.06 m, and widening the body cannot raise it above 0.0575 m, so speed is the remaining lever. Iteration 5 gave the s-bend a mean of 2.28 s, so a slowdown to 0.9 should land near 2.5 to 2.7 s, which is still under the 3 s limit. The candidate is valid and a clean single-variable step from the best design, so approve it and race it. Read the result as follows. If the slalom progress rises above 0.31 with max_error below 0.06 on some runs while the oval still finishes 20/20, speed was the limit: next try base_speed 0.85 if the s-bend completion_time stays under 2.9 s. If the s-bend completion_time exceeds 2.9 s or finishes fall below 17/20, return base_speed to 1.0. If slalom progress stays near 0.31 at the lower speed, the limit is sensor reach at the sharpest bend: next try y 0.075 with base_speed 0.9.
requested_changes: Keep base_speed at 0.9 and everything else as in iteration 5. Test whether the slalom's sharp turns are speed-limited, using iteration 5's slalom progress of 0.311 and max_error of 0.064 as the baseline.

If slalom progress rises above 0.31 and the oval still finishes 20/20, try base_speed 0.85 next, but only if the s-bend completion_time stays under 2.9 s. If the s-bend completion_time exceeds 2.9 s or s-bend finishes fall below 17/20, return base_speed to 1.0.
If slalom progress stays near 0.31 at base_speed 0.9, the limit is sensor reach at the sharpest bend. Next, keep base_speed 0.9 and move the sensors to y 0.075.
